headline: School board to vote on final readings of drug/alcohol and English learner policies, and consent items including hiring and financial reports.
summary: The board will act on the second readings of Policy B3 (Alcohol and Drug Free Workplace), Policy B4 (Drug and Alcohol Testing for Transportation Employees), and Policy C4 (English Learners). It will also review consent agenda items such as financial reports, hiring recommendations, and Policy 2.1 on treatment of students, parents, and guardians, then may enter executive session to discuss personnel matters.
